201:t_009:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「Watch out, $n! He'll come after you!」

201:t_009:12.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「His name is $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$. He hunts $$スフィア$$s and has fought us many times.」

201:t_009:13.en:
$$シン$$
「That bastard...! How did he break the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$'s seal!?」

201:t_009:15.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That man is a being who is not permitted to die.」

201:t_009:18.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「To be precise, no matter how many times we defeat him, he returns to life...」

201:t_009:19.en:
$$シン$$
「And every time, he appears before us hunting $$スフィア$$s.」

201:t_009:20.en:
$$アムロ$$
「To cut off his power source, we sealed him and his machine inside the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ on Mars, a system that extracts $$次元力$$.」

201:t_009:21.en:
$$アマタ$$
「If someone like that is back again...!」

201:t_009:22.en:
$$ランド$$
「Damn it...! It would've been better for all of us if you'd stayed asleep!」

201:t_009:23.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$アサキム$$! How did you escape the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$!?」

201:t_009:24.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I have no need to answer.」

201:t_009:26.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Sorry, but I'll deal with you later.」

201:t_009:27.en:
$$勝平$$
「What's with him!? Has he lost interest in $$スフィア$$s!?」

201:t_009:33.en:
$$ランド$$
「He's targeting $$サイデリアル$$'s $$リアクター$$s!?」

201:t_009:35.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Isn't it obvious? I'm here to hunt their $$スフィア$$s.」

201:t_009:36.en:
$$アサキム$$
「The $$悲しみの乙女$$, the $$傷だらけの獅子$$, and the $$いがみ合う双子$$... You are my insurance.」

201:t_009:37.en:
$n
「What...!? I sense $$スフィア$$s from him too...!」

201:t_009:38.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$アサキム$$ hunts $$スフィア$$s... And he already has several.」

201:t_009:39.en:
$$ランド$$
「If I remember right... The $$偽りの黒羊$$, the $$尽きぬ水瓶$$, the $$知りたがる山羊$$... And apparently one more.」

201:t_009:40.en:
$$勝平$$
「Damn! You have that many and you still want more!?」

201:t_009:42.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Will you laugh and call me wretched? But this is who I am.」

201:t_009:43.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You pitiful servants understand too, don't you? What I'm seeking.」

201:t_009:45.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Come on already. It's convenient for us that you've shown up too.」

201:t_009:48.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Stop, $$ランド$$! In a way, this is an opportunity!」

201:t_009:49.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Even I can tell, though I've got nothing to do with $$スフィア$$s... He's far stronger than before...」

201:t_009:50.en:
$$アサキム$$
「My time asleep wasn't wasted, you see.」

201:t_009:51.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If we use his power, we can get through this situation...」

201:t_009:53.en:
$$勝平$$
「I don't want to! I won't borrow power from someone like him!」

201:t_009:55.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I understand how you feel, but think about what we should do now.」

201:t_009:58.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Good boys. As long as you understand, that's enough.」

201:t_009:59.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, do not engage $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$...! Our targets are still the $$リアクター$$s!」

201:t_009:62.en:
$n
「So that's... the one who hunts $$スフィア$$s...」

201:t_009:63.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Now, let us begin... the banquet of the end.」

201:t_010:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have a relevant recommendation. Threat level cannot be measured. I advise immediate retreat.」

201:t_010:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I am upgrading my recommendation to a warning. Threat level cannot be measured. Failure to retreat immediately carries a high risk of total annihilation.」

201:t_010:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Even if we keep fighting... I see no chance of victory...」

201:t_010:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n! You're going to make me get out of $$ジェニオン$$ and throw your life away, aren't you!?」

201:t_010:11.en:
$n
「But this is our only chance! I'll launch a suicide attack with $$ジェニオン$$ and destroy that Imperial Palace!」

201:t_010:12.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You don't understand what you're saying!」

201:t_010:13.en:
$n
「With just my life, I can create hope of restoring peace!」

201:t_010:14.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Do you think no one will grieve if you die!?」

201:t_010:15.en:
$n
「...I don't think that... But if I can save everyone...」

201:t_010:18.en:
$$スズネ$$
「For the world!? For everyone!? Forget that! Live for me!」

201:t_010:20.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Please... Don't leave me... all alone again...」

201:t_010:23.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「The $$いがみ合う双子$$... The hope of saving the world and the despair of hurting someone precious have left you unable to act.」

201:t_010:24.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's your limit, $$リアクター$$ of a defective $$スフィア$$.」
